title: SMTP DATA body has no timeout — connection held open indefinitely
description: read_command_line() wraps byte reading in tokio::time::timeout(). read_data_body() — called after 354 is sent — has no timeout at all. Trigger: attacker sends EHLO+MAIL+RCPT+DATA, receives 354, then trickles one byte per minute or goes silent. Bad behavior: server connection held open forever, consuming fd and task slot until process resource limits are hit. SMTP command timeout (command_timeout_secs) only covers pre-DATA command reading; body phase is entirely unguarded. Fix: wrap the inner read loop in a per-idle-byte or per-DATA-body timeout, matching the existing command timeout config.
